items.t: "Service High Voltage System" warning with reduced power
items.job: Battery control module software update and resets (Service Bulletin 25-043)
items.note: Normally done free under Honda's warranty. If the warning returns, more repairs may be needed, still under the EV component warranty.

items.t: Clicking or popping from the front axles when turning
items.job: Inspect front drive axles and replace if damaged
items.note: A new car-age repair that should be covered by Honda's warranty. Parts have sometimes been backordered.

items.t: Heater blows cold or stops working
items.job: Battery control software update and heating system diagnosis
items.note: Hours are from GM's bulletin for the same problem on the Chevrolet Blazer EV, which shares the Prologue's platform. Covered by warranty.

items.t: Dead 12-volt battery, car won't power on
items.note: Often just needs a recharge and software update; a new battery is free if it fails under warranty.

items.t: Gauge cluster and center screen can go blank (recall)
items.note: Free at a Honda dealer under recall 26V-112.

items.t: Backup camera image blank or distorted (recall)
items.note: Free at a Honda dealer under recall 26V-306.

items.t: Right front lower control arm may crack (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace right front lower control arm
items.note: Free at a Honda dealer under recall 24V-540.

items.t: Sudden automatic braking with nothing in the way
items.job: Driver-assist sensor check, aiming and software update
items.note: Should be covered under Honda's new-vehicle warranty.

items.t: Car shifts to neutral while driving
items.job: Diagnose shifting fault and update software
items.note: Should be covered under Honda's new-vehicle warranty.

items.t: Car won't charge or charge port damaged
items.job: Diagnose charging fault; replace charging inlet if damaged
items.note: Covered under Honda's EV component warranty on these young cars.

items.job: Diagnose and recalibrate rear radar sensors
items.note: Should be covered under Honda's new-vehicle warranty unless the bumper was damaged.
